name: school-erp
description: Mother Teresa Foundation School ERP Management System

scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.db:migrate: cd backend && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:migrate:prod: cd backend && npx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:seed: cd backend && npx prisma db seed
scripts.db:reset: cd backend && npx prisma migrate reset --force
scripts.setup: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install && cd .. && npm run setup:chromium && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.setup:chromium: cd backend && npx puppeteer browsers install chrome
scripts.deploy:all: npm run deploy:build && npm run deploy:sql
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:backend && npm run typecheck:frontend
